resources.description: Proposed update to incomplete-grade criteria. Draft for review.
resources.content: Draft: an Incomplete (I) may be assigned when a student has completed at least 75% of course work and is unable to finish due to documented circumstances. The instructor files a completion plan with the registrar.

resources.title: Connecting to Campus Wi-Fi (eduroam)
resources.description: Step-by-step setup for laptops and phones.
resources.content:
1. Choose the network "eduroam".
2. Username: your full portal email.
3. Password: your portal password.
4. Accept the Demo University certificate when prompted.
Still stuck? Open a help desk ticket under IT Access.

resources.title: CS 501 Lab Environment Setup Guide
resources.description: Install PostgreSQL and the lab starter kit before Lab 1.
resources.content: Install PostgreSQL 16+, clone the lab starter repository from Canvas, and run `make check`. Bring your laptop to the first lab; loaners are available from the IT desk.
